event.title: Tracer released Echo
event.summary: Tracer is releasing Echo now to learn from real workloads and keep pushing the approach forward.

sourcePreview.title: We’re releasing Echo now to learn from real workloads and keep pushing the approach forward. Full evaluation methodology, results, and limitations: http://echo.tracerml.ai/eval
Today we’re launching Echo: Fable-level quality at ~1/3 the inference cost using open-weight models.

Today we’re launching Echo: Fable-level quality at ~1/3 the inference cost using open-weight models. Echo matches or nearly matches Fable on math, science, and the coding benchmarks we currently cover, while trailing on multilingual and broader knowledge. 🧵 https://t.co/eBmS43HmcW
